Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 6, Verse 6

“The self is the friend of one who has conquered the self by the self. But for one who has not, the self remains hostile, behaving like an enemy.”

The same faculty stands on both sides of the fight. Krishna refuses to blame outside forces for Arjuna's paralysis — the obstruction and the way through are one apparatus.
